title: The Green Guest Book  (绿色访客本)

segments.t: 在咖啡馆角落阳光充足的桌子旁，伊芙琳小姐在汉娜和亚瑟旁边扶了扶老花镜，翻开那本绿色布面的访客登记簿，找到了三十年前的五月。首先，请听整段场景。
Look how neat every page is: date, room number, guest name, and weather.
Turn to May tenth, Evelyn, the Friday written on our postcard!
Here it is! 'Heavy rain all night; water dripped onto the sunroom piano.'
Read the next line: 'Moved the piano to the dry corner; middle key swollen shut.'
Oh! That rainy night broke the roof and jammed middle D at the same time!
Look at my aunt's note underneath: 'Locked Room Nine until the roof is dry.'
And she tucked her unfinished waltz inside the lid to wait for sunny weather!
Then summer guests filled the house, years passed, and the bookcase went up.
She never got to hear the second half of her Friday waltz.
Arthur, with your permission, may I write the missing sixteen bars for Wednesday?
You would finish my aunt's song for our reopening, Evelyn?!
In the very same key, with her opening melody leading us home.
现在让我们逐句来看这段阅读材料。
Look how neat every page is: date, room number, guest name, and weather.
‘看每一页多整洁：日期、房间号、客人的名字和天气。’在用how引导的间接感叹句中，形容词紧跟在how后面，而动词放在从句末尾
how neat every page is:
其中neat突出了书写的工整。
Turn to May tenth, Evelyn, the Friday written on our postcard!
‘找找五月十号，伊芙琳，就是我们明信片上写的那个星期五！’当我们翻阅书本，直到找到特定的某一页或某一个日期时，准确的短语是
Turn to May tenth,
用序数词tenth来表示该月的那一天。
Here it is! 'Heavy rain all night; water dripped onto the sunroom piano.'
‘找到了！整夜倾盆大雨；水滴到了阳光房的钢琴上。’动词drip描述了水滴一点一点地落下，而复合介词短语
dripped onto
将向下的动作与接触木头的状态结合了起来。
Read the next line: 'Moved the piano to the dry corner; middle key swollen shut.'
‘看下一行：我们把钢琴移到了干燥的角落；中间的琴键膨胀卡住了。’在日记的电报式风格中，swell的不规则过去分词swollen与shut结合，如
swollen shut.'
因为湿气让木头膨胀，使其无法移动。
Oh! That rainy night broke the roof and jammed middle D at the same time!
‘哦！那个下雨的晚上不仅弄坏了屋顶，还同时卡住了中间的D键！’除了作为名词表示果酱之外，jam作为动词的意思是机械部件卡住或受阻：
jammed middle D
在键盘中音区的八度。
Look at my aunt's note underneath: 'Locked Room Nine until the roof is dry.'
‘看我姑姑在下面写的便条：九号房间锁上了，直到屋顶干了为止。’为了指出紧接在下一行写的内容而不用重复名词，可以使用副词
underneath:
比简单的under更有描述性。
And she tucked her unfinished waltz inside the lid to wait for sunny weather!
‘她把那首未完成的圆舞曲小心翼翼地收在琴盖里，等待晴天的到来！’动词tuck描绘了将某物小心放入或安全藏入缝隙中的动作：
tucked her unfinished waltz
在钢琴琴盖下保护着它。
Then summer guests filled the house, years passed, and the bookcase went up.
‘后来夏季的客人们住满了房子，岁月流逝，书架也建起来了。’当一个大件家具或一面墙被安装或立在空隙处时，只要说
the bookcase went up.
用三个片段结束了三十年的故事。
She never got to hear the second half of her Friday waltz.
‘她再也没机会听到她星期五圆舞曲的后半段了。’为了表达经历或实现某事的绝佳机会，get to后接不定式的用法是不可替代的：
never got to hear
带有很强的情感色彩。
Arthur, with your permission, may I write the missing sixteen bars for Wednesday?
‘亚瑟，如果可以的话，我能把周三缺的那十六个小节写出来吗？’伊芙琳在请求许可时表现出的礼貌令人赞赏，她用了
may I write
而放在名词前面的missing则意为‘缺失的’。
You would finish my aunt's song for our reopening, Evelyn?!
‘你愿意为我们的重新开业补全我姑姑的歌吗，伊芙琳！？’条件助动词would在这里表达了对提议的激动感激之情
You would finish
而reopening在opening前加了re-来庆祝重新开业。
In the very same key, with her opening melody leading us home.
‘在同一个调上，用它最初的旋律带我们回家。’在same前面，very这个词的意思不是‘非常’，而是加强了确切的同一性，就像在
the very same key,
利用了key作为琴键和调号的双重音乐含义。让我们重新听一遍完整的场景。
Look how neat every page is: date, room number, guest name, and weather.
Turn to May tenth, Evelyn, the Friday written on our postcard!
Here it is! 'Heavy rain all night; water dripped onto the sunroom piano.'
Read the next line: 'Moved the piano to the dry corner; middle key swollen shut.'
Oh! That rainy night broke the roof and jammed middle D at the same time!
Look at my aunt's note underneath: 'Locked Room Nine until the roof is dry.'
And she tucked her unfinished waltz inside the lid to wait for sunny weather!
Then summer guests filled the house, years passed, and the bookcase went up.
She never got to hear the second half of her Friday waltz.
Arthur, with your permission, may I write the missing sixteen bars for Wednesday?
You would finish my aunt's song for our reopening, Evelyn?!
In the very same key, with her opening melody leading us home.
阳光房关闭和未完成乐谱的谜团解开了，伊芙琳小姐主动提出要为星期三写完圆舞曲的结尾。再见！
Goodbye!
